# elves_faa_rule (Resource)

Manages a Santa File Access Authorization (FAA) rule, one `WatchItems` entry of the FAA policy that Elves exports into the Santa MDM profile. Every change bumps the policy version (see `elves_faa_settings`). See https://northpole.dev/features/faa/ for how Santa applies the rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only Slack (and Spotlight) may read or write Slack's cookies
resource "elves_faa_rule" "slack_cookies" {
  name      = "SlackCookies"
  rule_type = "PathsWithAllowedProcesses"

  paths = [
    { path = "/Users/*/Library/Application Support/Slack/Cookies", is_prefix = true },
    { path = "/Users/*/Library/Containers/com.tinyspeck.slackmacgap/Data/Library/Application Support/Slack/Cookies", is_prefix = true },
  ]

  processes = [
    { team_id = "BQR82RBBHL", signing_id = "com.tinyspeck.slackmacgap*" },
    { signing_id = "com.apple.mdworker_shared", platform_binary = true },
    { signing_id = "com.apple.mds", platform_binary = true },
  ]

  # Block, not only log, other processes. Defaults to true.
  audit_only = false

  block_message = "Only Slack may access Slack's cookies."
  description   = "Slack's cookies give access to your Slack account, so other apps may not read them."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Required. Unique name of the rule, the `WatchItems` key in the policy. 1-64 letters, digits and `. _ : -`.
- `paths` (Attributes List) Required. Paths the rule watches. At least one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--paths))
- `processes` (Attributes List) Required. Processes the rule applies to. At least one. A process matches only if every attribute that is set matches; set at least one of them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--processes))
- `rule_type` (String) Required. `PathsWithAllowedProcesses` or `PathsWithDeniedProcesses` protect the paths from all but (or only from) the processes; `ProcessesWithAllowedPaths` or `ProcessesWithDeniedPaths` limit the processes to (or keep them from) the paths.

### Optional

- `allow_read_access` (Boolean) Optional. Let every process read the paths, only writes are checked. Defaults to false.
- `audit_only` (Boolean) Optional. Only log accesses the rule would deny, as Santa does by default. Set to false to block them. Defaults to true.
- `block_message` (String) Optional. Message in the block dialog. Empty (the default) for Santa's message.
- `description` (String) Optional. Shown to users on the Elves FAA event page, not sent to Santa. Empty (the default) for none.
- `enable_silent_mode` (Boolean) Optional. Don't show the block dialog on the Mac. Defaults to false.
- `enable_silent_tty_mode` (Boolean) Optional. Don't print the block message in the terminal. Defaults to false.
- `event_detail_text` (String) Optional. Label of the dialog's button, at most 48 characters. Empty (the default) for the policy's.
- `event_detail_url` (String) Optional. URL the dialog's button opens, overrides the policy's (see `elves_faa_settings`). Must start with `https://`, may use Santa's placeholders. Empty (the default) for the policy's.
- `parent_directory_protection` (String) Optional. Whether Santa also guards renaming or deleting the paths' parent directories: `audit`, `enforce` or `disabled`. Only used by `Paths*` rules. Elves sets `enforce` on new `Paths*` rules that leave it out.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the FAA rule in Elves.
- `warnings` (List of String) Likely mistakes Elves found in the rule that Santa accepts, for example a path that another rule watches too.

<a id="nestedatt--paths"></a>
### Nested Schema for `paths`

Required:

- `path` (String) Required. Absolute path, may use the globs `*`, `?` and `[]` but not `**`. Santa doesn't follow symlinks, so use `/private/tmp`, `/private/var` and `/private/etc`.

Optional:

- `is_prefix` (Boolean) Optional. Also match everything below the path. Defaults to false.


<a id="nestedatt--processes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `processes`

Optional:

- `binary_path` (String) Optional. Absolute path of the binary, without globs.
- `cd_hash` (String) Optional. CDHash, 40 hex characters.
- `certificate_sha256` (String) Optional. SHA-256 of the leaf signing certificate, 64 hex characters.
- `platform_binary` (Boolean) Optional. Whether the process must be (true) or must not be (false) an Apple platform binary.
- `signing_id` (String) Optional. Signing ID, may end in `*`. A wildcard needs `team_id`, `platform_binary` or a `TEAMID:` or `platform:` prefix.
- `team_id` (String) Optional. Team ID, 10 uppercase letters or digits.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An FAA rule can be imported by its ID.
terraform import elves_faa_rule.example 3
```
